evidence: Three real worker processes had overlapping identification intervals and generated engine-owned terminal records.
A competing acquisition of the original machine-wide kernel lock was refused in every worker.
A simulated model usage limit stopped the other two workers and their real long-lived executor subprocesses; records were not falsely closed.
A lane-specific failed stage stopped only that lane; the two siblings closed normally and the batch was incomplete.
A simultaneous SIGINT to the supervisor and all lanes, followed by supervisor SIGTERMs, left no executor alive and released the lock.
A stalled lane was stopped at its hard ceiling, labeled deadline, and did not stop its siblings; no running attempt remained.
SIGTERM delivered inside Process.start, immediately after fork, reaped the registered child and released the kernel lock.
The frozen contract bound one owner target, recorded ignored literature-stage targets and the selection hash; an input bundle named .. was refused.
Quotas without the teardown reserve, a changed source PDF, a changed engine, and an unauthorized run location were refused.
A worker SIGKILLed after publishing its real executor left no live executor and released the lock.
SIGINT injected immediately after a forced worker kill did not skip the retained executor sweep.
A worker SIGKILLed during engine.sandboxed replay published the replay PID and left it dead after supervision.
Two lanes finishing during another lane's delayed cleanup retained done reports.
Three lanes ignoring SIGTERM were all stopped as deadline at one shared ceiling in under five seconds of a three-second test ceiling.
A changed frozen inventory and a problems/ symlink escaping the run directory were refused without writing outside.
Sandboxed replay accepted a real 7x13 factorization and rejected a malformed 7x11 witness.
A negative control accepting a valid witness failed the parent check.
Live snapshots were refused, incomplete batches failed, and an outside-directory write was denied.

real_selection_check.note: Validation streamed and hashed all three selected source PDFs and found no live executor or existing record.

credential_check: 2026-10-15: the CLI refresh-token hash matched 0 of 2 active OMP openai-codex rows. This establishes only unequal current values, not independent OAuth token families. CLI logins and model calls worked; no credential values were printed or changed.
limit: These checks use a synthetic model endpoint. They prove process lifecycle, isolation, contract binding, and refusal behavior, not live research or scientific correctness.
